description: This file defines functions and types related to configuring markdown table modes, including building default modes, resolving modes based on sections and channels, and handling configuration data for markdown tables within a larger application.

classes.name: MarkdownConfigEntry
classes.description: Type representing a markdown configuration entry, optionally containing table mode settings.

classes.name: MarkdownConfigSection
classes.description: Type extending MarkdownConfigEntry with optional accounts mapping for specific account configurations.

classes.name: ChannelMarkdownTableSurface
classes.description: Type representing surface configuration for a channel, including default markdown table mode.

methods.name: buildDefaultTableModes
methods.description: Builds a map of plugin IDs to their default markdown table modes based on bundled channel contract surface entries.

methods.name: getDefaultTableModes
methods.description: Returns cached or newly built default markdown table modes.

methods.name: resolveMarkdownModeFromSection
methods.description: Resolves the markdown table mode from a given configuration section and account ID.

methods.name: resolveMarkdownTableMode
methods.description: Determines the markdown table mode for a given configuration, channel, and account ID, with fallback to defaults.
